title: Ferizaj — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ferizaj: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ferizaj has a population of 60,000. A city in southeastern Kosovo known for its strategic location on the railway line, the annual Ferizaj City Days festival, and its growing industrial sector. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 149 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
